hook: Same user. Two countries. Eighteen minutes apart.
stat: Identity-based attacks rose thirty two percent in the first half of twenty twenty five.
intro: Here is how Mova iO handles a stolen sign-in, before the attacker gets far.
s1: Entra I D Protection flags Arjun, a plant manager, as high risk. He signed in from Mumbai at nine, and again from Amsterdam eighteen minutes later, through an anonymous proxy, with a valid session token.
s2: In Microsoft Defender, the triage agent pulls the story together. The token was stolen through a fake sign-in page. Within minutes, the attacker created an inbox rule to hide replies about invoices. No email has been sent yet.
s3: The agent recommends revoking every session, forcing a password reset, and removing the rule. It leaves the account enabled so Arjun can keep working. The SOC lead approves in Teams.
s4: In Entra, sessions are revoked and the user is confirmed compromised, which triggers a secure password reset at his next sign-in. In Defender, the inbox rule is removed and the proxy address is blocked.
s5: Arjun gets a clear message in Teams: what happened, what was done, and how to sign in again.
s6: The security incident closes in ServiceNow with the full timeline, and the fake sign-in page is reported for takedown.
close: A stolen session caught in minutes. The attacker locked out. The user back at work the same morning.
tag: Identity threats, contained by Mova iO agents. With people in control.
end: Movate. Your applied A I partner.
